modify.note: WebhookTaskerProducerService stops queuing webhook deliveries through InternalTasker and hands them to the new WebhookTasker instead; its comments should say deliveries go through Trigger.dev, not InternalTasker. WebhookTaskConsumer stays the code that actually delivers a queued webhook.

add_nodes.label: WebhookTasker
add_nodes.summary: Picks sync or Trigger.dev delivery for webhook tasks based on ENABLE_ASYNC_TASKER.
add_nodes.description: Follows the BookingEmailAndSmsTasker pattern: a common webhook tasker contract with a sync implementation that runs the consumer immediately and a trigger implementation that queues to Trigger.dev, plus a main tasker that chooses between them. Wired through DI modules and tokens with the bindModuleToClassOnToken pattern.
add_nodes.note: When ENABLE_ASYNC_TASKER is true (production) deliveries are queued to Trigger.dev; when it is false (E2E) they run immediately so webhooks are delivered without the cron. Each delivery returns a task id.

add_nodes.label: Deliver webhook Trigger.dev task
add_nodes.summary: Trigger.dev task that delivers one queued webhook.
add_nodes.note: Validates the payload against the existing webhook task payload schema, gets WebhookTaskConsumer from the DI container and runs it. Queue runs with concurrency 20 and retries up to 3 attempts.

add_edges.label: delivers webhook task
add_edges.note: The producer service sends each webhook task payload to WebhookTasker rather than InternalTasker.

add_edges.label: sync: runs WebhookTaskConsumer
add_edges.note: In sync mode the webhook is processed right away by calling WebhookTaskConsumer directly.

add_edges.label: async: triggers deliver-webhook
add_edges.note: In async mode the trigger tasker loads the deliver-webhook task lazily and triggers it with the payload.

add_edges.label: runs WebhookTaskConsumer
add_edges.note: The Trigger.dev task delivers the webhook through WebhookTaskConsumer.
